newsitem.title: USA: Datascope sees Q2 exceeding expectations.
newsitem.headline: Datascope sees Q2 exceeding expectations.

text.p: Datascope Corp said Tuesday its operating results for the second quarter ended December 31 would exceed Wall Street expectations.
According to First Call, analysts' consensus earnings estimates for the quarter is $0.27 a share.

The company estimated that net earnings for the period would be above the year-ago period, excluding last year's income from the settlement of litigation, on a 10 percent rise in consolidated revenues.
In the year-ago second quarter, the company posted earnings of $0.29 per share before income from the litigation settlement.

The company said higher domestic sales of new models of the Passport monitor and continued strong growth in sales of the VasoSeal vascular sealing device in the U.S. produced the stronger than expected sales gain.
